notes.subject: ka
notes.rationale: Bambara possessive link required between 'siyaw' and 'laadili'; Hebrew construct is bound with no separate word.

notes.subject: laadili / hakilijagow
notes.rationale: Parallel pair: counsel (עצה) against thoughts/devices (מחשבות), nations (גוים) against peoples (עמים) — a chiastic mirror of v.11.

notes.subject: tiɲɛ bɔ
notes.rationale: הפיר literally 'he crushed/broke'; rendered as 'brought to nothing', matching the crushing image.

translation: Yawe ye ⟨את⟩ siyaw ka laadili tiɲɛ bɔ; a ye mɔgɔw ka hakilijagow jɔsi.
